text.Timeless Livingに寄せられるお問い合わせにお答えしております。: Answers to the questions we are most often asked.
text.Q.マンション以外のリフォームには対応していますか？: Q. Do you take on work other than apartments?
text.Q.「Timeless Living」の対応エリアを教えて下さい。: Q. Which areas does Timeless Living work in?
text.Q.珪藻土は施工しないのですか？: Q. Do you not use diatomaceous earth plaster?
text.Q.ビニールクロスは使用しないのですか？: Q. Do you not use vinyl wallcovering?
text.Q.リビングや廊下に石を敷き詰めたりしないのですか？: Q. Do you not lay stone in living rooms and hallways?
text.マンションリフォーム専門とさせて頂いており、戸建住宅については対応しておりません: We work only on apartment renovation, and do not take on detached houses.
text.設計・施工・工事管理を全て社内で行っておりますため、対応エリアを東京都内および神: Because we keep design, construction and site management entirely in-house, we work within Tokyo and parts of Kanagawa only.
text.珪藻土と漆喰を混同されるお客様が多いのですが、珪藻土はそれ自身で硬化することがで: Diatomaceous earth and lime plaster are often confused. Diatomaceous earth cannot set by itself and has no binding power of its own, so it is mixed with a synthetic adhesive. Lime plaster, by contrast, sets on its own when water is added, as cement does, and goes on hardening as the years pass. A binder is used to stop it cracking as it does so — but the Mutenka Jutaku lime plaster we use contains, as its name says, no additives at all: no synthetic adhesive, only natural binders such as seaweed. For design that the body registers as comfortable, we recommend lime plaster with no synthetic adhesive on the large surfaces, the walls and ceilings.
text.ビニールクロスは静電気がおきるため汚れが吸い寄せられ、時間が経つと汚れてきます。: Vinyl wallcovering builds up static, which draws dirt to it, so it grows dirty over time. And if it burns, in a fire, it gives off dioxins and other harmful substances. We recommend materials that carry little static and release nothing harmful — lime plaster, and paper wallcoverings.
text.石という素材は人間から熱を直接伝導してしまうため、靴を脱ぐという日本人の生活様式: Stone conducts heat straight out of the body. In a Japanese household, where shoes come off at the door, we believe that tells on the body over the years, and so we do not recommend it.
text.工事後保証書を発行し、1年間のアフターサービス期間を設けております。アフターサー: We issue a warranty certificate on completion and provide a one-year aftercare period. If something goes wrong after that period we deal with it all the same. With the clients we have worked for, the relationship has continued long after they moved in.

description: Why we work only on apartments in Tokyo and parts of Kanagawa, why we use lime plaster rather than diatomaceous earth or vinyl, and what the one-year aftercare covers.
